about.description: Zeke's Landing and Marina sits just across the street from some of the most beautiful beaches in the country. A mere 10-minute boat ride from the Gulf of Mexico. Zeke's boasts a long history of excellence in the charter fishing industry and proudly hosts the largest charter fleet on the Gulf. The facility offers a variety of dry dock options, premier customer service, and an environmentally friendly approach to operating a marina.
about.elevator_pitch: Orange Beach's premier fishing charter marina with the largest fleet on Alabama's Gulf Coast, offering inshore and offshore fishing, cruises, dining, and dry storage.
about.vibe: Family-friendly, adventurous, nautical, welcoming to all experience levels
about.reservations: Available for restaurant and private charters
about.insider_tip: Zeke's restaurant offers 'hook and cook' service - catch your fish and have the restaurant prepare it. Best place to watch sunsets on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
